scopingRule: Coverage is PARTIAL. Every count is phrased 'in the sets we track'. An 'only N ever' claim is forbidden from this data.

angles.post:
Test Illustrator A has illustrated 3 Pokémon cards in the sets we track.

• Umbreon VMAX — Evolving Skies ($2,244)
• Rayquaza VMAX — Evolving Skies ($1,248)
• Umbreon ex — Prismatic Evolutions ($1,491)

A small body of work is easy to hold in your head, which is its own kind of collectable.
angles.why: A short catalogue is inherently interesting and easy to verify. The scoping phrase is what stops it becoming a claim a reader can disprove.

angles.post:
Umbreon VMAX from Evolving Skies sits at $2,244 ungraded.

It was illustrated by Test Illustrator A, who has 3 cards in the sets we track.

Everyone can tell you what this card costs. Fewer can tell you who drew it.
angles.why: Art accounts have the taste and none of the data. Price accounts have the data and never look at who drew it. This is the only lane that holds both.
